title: KestrelCare Facility Payment Terms: Late-Payment Interest
content:
**Clause.** Late-payment interest is added to a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair payment when the payment is made late, counted in calendar days from the decision date to the payment date: beyond 10 days (the long late-payment days) the long late interest of 2 percent is added, beyond 2 days (the short late-payment days) but not beyond 10 days the short late interest of 1 percent is added, and within 2 days none is added.

The decision date is the date of the plan's approved claim decision entry being paid; the payment date is the day the payment is made. The interest is added by multiplying the amount by one plus the interest, before the payment is compared with the coverage remaining.

| Calendar days from decision to payment | Interest added |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | none |
| 3 to 10 | 1 percent |
| 11 or more | 2 percent |

*Hypothetical:* a decision dated 1 October and an amount of 1500.00: paid 3 October, 1500.00; paid 4 October, 1515.00; paid 12 October, 1530.00.
